title: Build agent-ready Boğaziçi sustainability research pack
acceptance_criteria: Official Boğaziçi 2025 sustainability sources are converted into narrow source-backed facts with provenance and caveats
Public-source research is explicitly separated from PMR/interview evidence and measured pilot evidence
Food-waste data quality anomalies and unsupported causal inferences are called out rather than silently normalized
Peer-reviewed university food-service forecasting literature is summarized as benchmark evidence, not as proof of Boğaziçi workflow
IE, EE, CS1 and CS2 each receive concrete handoff questions/actions grounded in the research
A machine-readable JSON companion exposes facts, hypotheses, caveats, source URLs and role handoffs for other agents
notes: Do not edit KREATE/EVIDENCE.md or KREATE/ASSUMPTIONS.md while TASK-CS1-DECISION-CORE owns those paths.
This package is secondary/public-source research only; it must never be counted as PMR or customer validation.
Source values are transcribed with semantic caveats where the university tables appear internally inconsistent.
